lines.en: I walk step by step, heavily.

lines.zh: 我的影子很长，压着地面。
lines.en: My shadow is long and lies on the ground.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草都不动。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass does not stir.
I lift a foot and hold it a moment.
I walk toward the light.
I know the stones on this path.

lines.zh: 时间在我身边变得很慢。
lines.en: Time runs slow around me.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块很久以前的石头。
lines.en: I go around a stone from long ago.

lines.zh: 我身上的纹路在发暗光。
lines.en: The marks on me give a dim glow.

lines.zh: 我的脚步和地面的震一致。
lines.en: My steps match the tremor in the ground.
I stand like an old pillar.

lines.zh: 我手里的东西在慢慢转。
lines.en: What I hold turns slowly.

lines.zh: 那东西的光不刺眼，很深。
lines.en: Its light is not sharp. It is deep.
I press my hand to the strata and listen.

lines.zh: 那个时刻已经来过一次了。
lines.en: That moment has come once already.

lines.zh: 这里的空气和我的时代不同。
lines.en: The air here is not my era's air.
I raise my head and look at the sky.
The clouds move slower than they should.
I count their shadows.
One by one, east to west.
I forget the count again.
How many times now.
I count the years in the rock strata.
The wind goes around me.
Even it will not pass through.
I wait right here.
You stand far off. Good.

lines.zh: 我看向你，你看不出我在想什么。
lines.en: I look at you. You cannot tell what I think.
There is time on you.
Very short, and bright.
I can see it going round in rings.

lines.zh: 你抬手，那圈就快了一点。
lines.en: You raise a hand and the ring quickens.
I reach out, then withdraw.
I should not touch it.

lines.zh: 你说话了，声音传得很慢。
lines.en: You speak, and the sound comes slowly.

lines.zh: 我听得懂，只是要等一等。
lines.en: I understand, but I must wait for it.
Where you stand was once sea.
I never give chase.
The wound is shallow; time will mend it.

lines.zh: 身上有一道痕亮了一下。
lines.en: A mark on me flares once.
I made no sound at all.
Stone chips fall from my shoulder.
Then I lower it again.

lines.zh: 这点伤，过一会儿就没了。
lines.en: This wound will be gone in a while.
I stand and wait for it to close.

lines.zh: 我被击中，动作慢了半息。
lines.en: Struck, my motion slows by half a breath.

lines.zh: 时光宝石在我掌心发凉。
lines.en: The Time Gem lies cold in my palm.
That blow won't reach the bone.
There is time in that.
I see it. Very faint.
I reach out and stop.

lines.zh: 时光宝石就藏在我的骨缝里。
lines.en: The Time Gem hides between my bones.
I draw my hand back.
You hold it out; I do not reach.

lines.zh: 这个时代的东西我不吃。
lines.en: I do not eat the things of this age.
Only that one piece is mine.
Put it away. Do not bring it out again.
I turn away and stop looking.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，像撞上一段年轮。
lines.en: You strike me as against a tree ring.
I do not sway at all.
You fall back two steps. I saw.
I put out a hand to steady you.
My hand is very cold.
You pull your hand away.
That I understand.
My time gem sits at my chest.

lines.zh: 你走过去，我数着你的脚步。
lines.en: You pass, and I count your steps.
Seventeen in all.

lines.zh: 我记不清那是多久以前了。
lines.en: I cannot recall how long ago it was.
There were others here then.
Now only I remain.
What I hold is still turning.
It remembers. I do not.
I close my hand.
Wind passes between my fingers.
I stood there a long while.
Then I go on waiting.
It is the only thing I know how to do.

lines.zh: 我把碎裂的化石拼回原样。
lines.en: I fit the shattered fossil back together.

lines.zh: 我掂了掂，它的重量很熟悉。
lines.en: I weigh it; its heft is familiar.
It has almost no weight.
Not from my era.

lines.zh: 我捏起一块化石，对着光看。
lines.en: I pinch up a fossil and hold it to the light.
I set it squarely.
So the next one can find it.
I step one pace off.
One look, then I go.
Time is still moving on.

lines.zh: 我感到了不属于这个纪元的呼吸。
lines.en: I sense a breath that doesn't belong to this era.
I raise my head up.
Something brightens behind my eyes.
It carries time about it.
Not much, but enough.
The Time Gem is in my hand.
The light spreads and falls on the ground.
That patch of ground slows.
It steps in and its motion lags.
I walk toward it.
No hurry. It cannot run fast.
I walk step by step.
It looks back, slowly.

lines.zh: 时光宝石的光，我看得见。
lines.en: I can see the Time Gem's glow.

lines.zh: 我掉的时光宝石，能穿回白垩纪。
lines.en: The Time Gem I drop can send you back to the Cretaceous.
The light contracts.

lines.zh: 时光宝石在我爪里，时间到了。
lines.en: The Time Gem is in my claw. Time's up.
When it is over, I will go on waiting.
I follow it, not quickly.
It runs a way, then slows.
Not weariness. Time.
I lay the light before it.
It goes around; I lay more.
Ring by ring, closing.
Its steps begin to repeat.

lines.zh: 同一块石头，它踩了三次。
lines.en: The same stone, three times.
It has not noticed.
I stand outside the ring.
Only wait.
Time inside the ring is mine.
It reaches and touches the moment before.
It retreats into still earlier.
It has stopped.
It has understood.
I simply watch it.
It looks up at me.
Neither of us spoke.
I bring my hand up before my chest.

lines.zh: 我一掌按下，地面陷了一块。
lines.en: I press a palm down and the ground gives.
Light spills from the edge of my palm.
It is struck, and moves very slowly.

lines.zh: 我抬手，把对手按进土里。
lines.en: I raise a hand and press my foe into the dirt.
This one is heavier.

lines.zh: 它退了两步，退得很吃力。
lines.en: It falls back two steps, with effort.
I stay my hand.
It kneels on the ground.
I move no more.
The light in my hand dims.
I do not look back.
Time to go.
I walk away, step by step.
There is no sound behind me.

lines.zh: 我从一道裂口里走出来。
lines.en: I come out through a rift.
It closes behind me.
The wind here is new.

lines.zh: 我手里的东西亮了一下。
lines.en: What I hold glows once.
It knows this place.
I do not know this place.

lines.zh: 我站在空地上，等裂口再开。
lines.en: I stand in the open and wait for the rift.
It will not open soon.
So I will walk first.

lines.zh: 三个纪元的风景，我都走过。
lines.en: I have walked the landscapes of three eras.
There are far too many trees.

lines.zh: 抬头闻了闻，时光的味道。
lines.en: Nose up. The smell of time.
Living things, and many.
Their times are all very short.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，看见的是陌生天空。
lines.en: I open my eyes to an unfamiliar sky.
Stones crack under my feet.

lines.zh: 我从岩层里迈出第一步。
lines.en: I take my first step out of the rock strata.
I never hurry.
One place is the same as another.
I will simply wait on.

lines.zh: 火烧过来，到我身边就慢了。
lines.en: Fire comes and slows as it nears me.

lines.zh: 我落下去，地面被我砸出一个圈。
lines.en: I fall and a ring is smashed into the ground.

lines.zh: 水漫过我，气泡浮上去，很慢。
lines.en: Water covers me and bubbles rise, slowly.

lines.zh: 爆炸的光散开，我只退了半步。
lines.en: Blast light spreads. I give only half a step.

lines.zh: 一支箭停在我面前，落了下去。
lines.en: An arrow halts before me and drops.

lines.zh: 另一种时间和我的撞在一起。
lines.en: Another time collides with mine.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是力量在减少。
lines.en: I do not eat. I only dwindle.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，被拉成一道很慢的光。
lines.en: Lightning falls, drawn into a slow line.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有时间，我第一次觉得久。
lines.en: In the void there is no time. For once, it feels long.
